description: The open source AI coding agent. (v2)
notes: The v2 configuration is incompatible with v1. Uninstall 'opencode' first, then install this version.
pre_install: $v = (opencode --version 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1); if ($v -match '^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)') { $cur = "$($Matches[1]).$($Matches[2]).$($Matches[3])"; if ([int]$Matches[1] -lt 2) { Write-Host "opencode v$cur is already installed."; Write-Host 'The v2 configuration is incompatible with v1. Please run ''scoop uninstall opencode'' first.'; Write-Host 'See https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/migrate-v1/ for migration steps.'; exit 1 } }
